parameters.subdivisionLevelDescription: Controls spherical mesh subdivision. Higher levels create more regions and use more memory and GPU memory.
parameters.randomSeedDescription: Determines the random sequence. The same seed, parameters, and algorithm version reproduce the same result.

irregularity.label: Mesh irregularity
irregularity.description: Controls positional perturbation of spherical sample points. Higher values produce a less regular mesh.

primaryPlateCount.label: Primary plate count
primaryPlateCount.description: Target number of primary moving plates. Plate shape and splittable regions affect the final count.

microPlateCount.label: Target microplate count
microPlateCount.description: Target number of microplates near primary plate boundaries. The final count may be lower due to boundary and connectivity constraints.

plateSizeVariety.label: Plate area variation
plateSizeVariety.description: Controls variation in target plate areas. Higher values increase the area gap between large and small plates.

continentCount.label: Target candidate continents
continentCount.description: Target number of candidate continental regions. Plate connectivity and area constraints may reduce the final count.

candidateLandCoverage.label: Target candidate land coverage
candidateLandCoverage.description: Share of the sphere covered by candidate continents. Final coastlines depend on elevation and sea level, so they may differ from candidate regions.

continentSizeVariety.label: Candidate continent area variation
continentSizeVariety.description: Controls target area differences between candidate continents. Higher values make continents of very different sizes more likely.

islandArcCount.label: Target island arc count
islandArcCount.description: Upper limit on island arc source points along oceanic subduction zones. Plate boundary constraints mean this is not the final island count.

islandDensity.label: Island density
islandDensity.description: Adjusts the tendency, range, and relief of island arc terrain fragments and small coastal islands; it does not specify the final island count.

hotspotCount.label: Target hotspot count
hotspotCount.description: Target number of mantle hotspot chains. Available positions and spacing constraints may reduce the final count.

roughness.label: Terrain roughness
roughness.description: Adjusts terrain noise amplitude, affecting detail strength in mountains, plains, and coasts.

terrainWarp.label: Terrain warp
terrainWarp.description: Adjusts how much noise coordinates bend, creating more stretched and twisting terrain patterns.

smoothing.label: Terrain smoothing
smoothing.description: Adjusts elevation smoothing. Higher values create gentler transitions but reduce local detail.

hydraulicErosion.label: Hydraulic erosion
hydraulicErosion.description: Adjusts simplified hydraulic erosion strength; its current effect is multiplied by 0.5.

glacialErosion.label: Glacial erosion
glacialErosion.description: Adjusts simplified glacial erosion, affecting highland carving and valley shaping.

ridgeSharpening.label: Ridge sharpening
ridgeSharpening.description: Increases local contrast and steepness in tectonic mountains and ridges.

axialTilt.label: Axial tilt (°)
axialTilt.description: Controls the tilt of the planet's rotation axis relative to its orbital plane, affecting seasonal temperature ranges and precipitation patterns.

orbitalPeriod.label: Orbital period (Earth days)
orbitalPeriod.description: Controls year length and the time scale of the seasonal climate cycle.

temperatureOffset.label: Temperature offset (°C)
temperatureOffset.description: Shifts monthly temperatures globally. At −40°C, tropical seas fall below the freezing point of seawater; at +60°C, tropical temperatures reach the monthly upper limit and even high elevation areas can rise above freezing in their warmest month.

precipitationScale.label: Precipitation scale
precipitationScale.description: Scales modeled precipitation. Higher values produce more precipitation overall.

degreeDayMeltFactor.label: Degree-day melt factor (mm / °C / month)
degreeDayMeltFactor.description: Snow water equivalent melted each month per degree Celsius above the melt threshold; this is a simplified temperature-index model.

evapotranspirationFactor.label: Evapotranspiration temperature factor (mm / °C / month)
evapotranspirationFactor.description: How much evapotranspiration demand increases with temperature; this is a temperature-index approximation, not a full evapotranspiration model.

riverDensityMultiplier.label: River network density multiplier
riverDensityMultiplier.description: Lower values raise the drainage area threshold and produce fewer rivers. The default is 0.5, twice the original default threshold. Climate runoff and terrain flow both constrain the result.

minimumRiverDrainageArea.label: Baseline drainage area
minimumRiverDrainageArea.description: The river threshold is the larger of this value and 16 times the average cell area, then scaled by river network density. Logarithmic area scale: 0–10,000,000 km². Higher baselines usually produce fewer rivers.

minimumLakeArea.label: Minimum lake area
minimumLakeArea.description: After climate filtering, lakes smaller than this area are removed. Depression fills under 1 m average depth do not form lakes. At 0, basins must cover at least two regions. Logarithmic area scale: 0–10,000,000 km².

parameters.highLevelWarning: High-level meshes contain many regions and use more GPU and system memory.

civilization.notAvailable: Civilization generation will be added in M2. The current M3 cartography system focuses on rendering complete natural world snapshots as 3D globes and 2D atlases.
